profile_text.body:
WeRide Inc. describes itself as a commercial-stage global company that develops autonomous driving technologies from Level 2 to Level 4. Its site highlights the WeRide One universal autonomous driving technology platform, a self-developed foundational toolchain, and accumulated real-world operational data. The company says its business footprint spans more than 60 cities across 13 countries, and it offers a portfolio of five core products, including Robotaxi.

The company states it is listed on Nasdaq under the ticker WRD and on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under the ticker 0800. It also says it has been recognized in Fortune's 2026 Change the World and 2025 Future 50 lists.

SEC records identify WeRide Inc. as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001867729 and ticker WRD, headquartered in Guanzhou.
